states.name: ALL_STOPPED
states.description: All internal run commands are FALSE; pumpGroup[*].RunComd is FALSE.

states.name: MANUAL_RUNNING
states.description: Run commands latched from the last manual start; mode or selection changes without start are ignored.

states.name: AUTO_RUNNING
states.description: Run commands latched from the last automatic start; mode or priority changes without start are ignored.

actions: sort pumps by pumpGroup[i].priority descending, tie by lower array index
runCmd[i] := TRUE for the first three sorted pumps and FALSE for the other two

transitions.note: Mode, priority, and selection changes do not reselect without start.

timer_plan.notes: No TON/TOF/TP timing is specified. Stage 3 of the scan is an explicit no-op.

safety: stop has highest priority and overrides start; when stop is TRUE all pumpGroup[1..5].RunComd are FALSE.
Only pumpGroup[i].RunComd may be written; pumpGroup[i].priority and pumpGroup[i].selection must remain unchanged.
Initial RunComd state is FALSE and remains FALSE until a valid start command.
No timer delay or automatic retry may delay or override stop.
operational: Manual mode: start latches RunComd[i] := selection[i].
Automatic mode: start selects exactly three pumps with the highest priority; ties break by lower array index.
start is level-sensitive and reselects on every TRUE scan; stop and start are evaluated with stop first.
When neither stop nor start is TRUE, hold all RunComd values; mode, priority, or selection changes alone do not reselect.
Selection is ignored in automatic mode; priority is ignored for manual pump selection except as read-only data.

scan_execution_order: 1. Edge sampling: sample all inputs once at scan start: modeSampled := mode; startSampled := start; stopSampled := stop; prioritySampled[i] := pumpGroup[i].priority; selectionSampled[i] := pumpGroup[i].selection; runPrev[i] := pumpGroup[i].RunComd. No R_TRIG/F_TRIG is required because start and stop are level-sensitive.

2. Safety/reset priority and state transitions: apply stop first. If stopSampled then set state := ALL_STOPPED and runCmd[1..5] := FALSE. Else if startSampled then reselect: if !modeSampled then runCmd[i] := selectionSampled[i] and state := MANUAL_RUNNING; else runCmd[i] := TRUE for the top three pumps by prioritySampled descending with lower-index tie-break and FALSE otherwise, state := AUTO_RUNNING. Else hold state and runCmd unchanged. Never write priority or selection.

3. Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: no timer FBs are required by this specification, so this stage is an explicit no-op. Future timer FB calls would be invoked unconditionally here before output assignment.

4. Unified output assignments: write only pumpGroup[i].RunComd := runCmd[i] for i=1..5. Do not write pumpGroup[i].priority or pumpGroup[i].selection. All observed outputs are assigned after the state-transition logic.

formal_assertions.formula: G((!stop & start & !mode) -> ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd = pumpGroup[1].selection) & (pumpGroup[2].RunComd = pumpGroup[2].selection) & (pumpGroup[3].RunComd = pumpGroup[3].selection) & (pumpGroup[4].RunComd = pumpGroup[4].selection) & (pumpGroup[5].RunComd = pumpGroup[5].selection)))

G((!stop & start & mode) -> ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd <-> TopThree1) & (pumpGroup[2].RunComd <-> TopThree2) & (pumpGroup[3].RunComd <-> TopThree3) & (pumpGroup[4].RunComd <-> TopThree4) & (pumpGroup[5].RunComd <-> TopThree5)))

G((!stop & !start) -> ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd = runPrev[1]) & (pumpGroup[2].RunComd = runPrev[2]) & (pumpGroup[3].RunComd = runPrev[3]) & (pumpGroup[4].RunComd = runPrev[4]) & (pumpGroup[5].RunComd = runPrev[5])))
